cohort: Pregnant people who had live births from January 1, 2013, through December 31, 2022, in an integrated U.S. community healthcare system.
finding: Patients with IMIDs had an increased risk of preterm birth, low birth weight, small for gestational age, and caesarean section, but these associations were attenuated after adjusting for comorbidities.
mod_finding: Patients with one or more of these 12 IMIDs had increased risk of caesarean section (RR = 1.1 [1.1, 1.2], p < 0.0001) compared to a matched cohort of people without IMIDs.
